scenario.title: An irreversible step with no authorisation is refused
scenario.why: The run is approved and unattended but carries no authorisation, so the risk ceiling is held below the capability's declared maximum and the submit is refused. With no operator available the escalation times out, which is reported as an abort -- nobody said it was safe.

steps.intent: Open the servicing console entry screen
Enter the operator user ID to sign on to the servicing console.
steps.target: textbox "User ID" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (textbox labelled "User ID")

steps.intent: Enter the operator password to sign on to the servicing console.
